en.title: Montenegro: up to 31 cm of new snow on the way, most of it on Thursday 26 November
en.description: Montenegro: up to 31 cm of new snow on the way, most of it on Thursday 26 November
en.lede: The week ahead could bring up to 31 cm to the snowiest slopes in Montenegro, 8 cm of it in the next three days. The biggest day looks like Thursday 26 November, with up to 24 cm.

p: Forecasts this far out move. The timing is usually more reliable than the totals, so keep a flexible plan and check again two days before you go.
In Montenegro, about 390 km² of high ground is white today, 380 km² more than yesterday. Roughly 3 % of the country's mapped mountains and hills are covered.
The week ahead could bring up to 31 cm, 8 cm of it in the next three days.
The snowiest day looks like Thursday 26 November, with up to 24 cm in the snowiest spots.
Ski centar Savin kuk leads with 6 cm on its upper slopes.
At Ski centar Savin kuk: 5 cm of fresh snow over three days, 20 cm more expected by Monday 23 November.
Snow lies on the upper slopes of 1 out of 3 resorts in Montenegro.
The last three days were dry or nearly so, with no more than 2 cm anywhere.
Day by day, the white area in Montenegro went: 16 November 80 km²; 17 November 20 km²; 18 November 20 km²; 19 November 10 km²; 20 November 390 km².
Ski centar Savin kuk has been the deepest resort every day this week.
By height, the picture looks like this: between 1,500 and 2,000 m, under 1 cm on average, 13 % covered; between 2,000 and 2,500 m, 2 cm on average, 55 % covered.
The snow line sits near 2,100 m. Last week's 200 km² has grown by 190 km².

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Bosnia and Herzegovina: 0 % white, deepest OC Bjelašnica ZOI '84 with 0 cm, up to 30 cm in the week ahead; Albania: 3 % white, deepest Ski Pista Bigëll with 0 cm, up to 24 cm in the week ahead.

sections.h: Planning a day on the snow
p: Between 2,000 m and 2,500 m the cover is patchy, about 55 % white: expect grass and stones between the snow.
Below 1,500 m the slopes are still almost bare.
Each day adds white ground, a good sign for the resorts that rely on natural snow.
With more snow in the forecast, the next days should improve things further.

advice: Fresh snow on a cold base sticks badly: take care on steep slopes.
Early-season snow is thin over rocks: ski the groomed runs first.
Morning snow is firm after a clear night: wait for the sun on south faces.

cnr.title: Snijeg u Crnoj Gori danas: visina snježnog pokrivača i novi snijeg, 20. novembra 2026.
cnr.description: Snijeg u Crnoj Gori 20. novembra: snježni pokrivač, novi snijeg, visina po nadmorskoj visini, naredni dani i najbolji ski-centri.
cnr.lede: Petak, 20. novembra: snijeg pokriva oko 390 km² planina u Crnoj Gori. To je 380 km² više nego jučer. To je 3 % planinskog područja u Crnoj Gori koje pratimo.

p: Snježna granica je oko 2.100 m. U odnosu na 200 km² prije sedam dana, to je rast od 190 km².
Posljednja tri dana gotovo nije padao snijeg: maksimum je 2 cm.
Bijela površina raste i ako se hladnoća zadrži, mogu proraditi novi liftovi.
Visina snijega zavisi od nadmorske visine: 1.500–2.000 m: prosječno manje od 1 cm (13 % pod snijegom); 2.000–2.500 m: prosječno 2 cm (55 % pod snijegom).
Prednjači Ski centar Savin kuk: 6 cm na gornjem dijelu staza.
U naredna tri dana očekuje se do 8 cm, a za cijelu sedmicu do 31 cm.
Najsnježniji dan: četvrtak, 26. novembra, do 24 cm.

advice: Na početku sezone snijeg je tanak iznad kamenja: držite se uređenih staza.
